summary: iHuman Inc. filed a Form 6-K (unaudited Q1 2026 financial results) and in the press release announced the co-opting of Mr. Teng Li as Co-Chief Executive Officer and Ms. Congyu Lin as Chief Strategy Officer. No price, stake, or premium terms are disclosed. The board did not issue a recommendation or name advisors; the changes are effective immediately. Structurally, this is a management reshuffling to strengthen leadership for growth. Watch for potential strategic shifts under the new co-CEO structure, but no explicit M&A or special-situation event is triggered beyond the executive changes.
